scenes.title: The Ninth Key
scenes.summary: Saturday morning at the front desk: Mina, Junho, and Sungmin open the dusty cedar box stamped 'Room 9' with the small brass key.

scenes.title: Move the Books
scenes.summary: Sora joins Mina and Junho in the back hallway to unload the heavy wooden bookcase and uncover a narrow painted door.

scenes.title: Glass and Dust
scenes.summary: Mina, Sora, and Sungmin step into Room 9—a forgotten glass garden sunroom overlooking the side of the courtyard.

scenes.title: Under the White Sheet
scenes.summary: Guest and retired piano teacher Youngmi helps Mina and Junho pull back the white cloth, revealing an old wooden upright piano.

scenes.title: Measuring the Sunroom
scenes.summary: Acoustic architect Jihoon and his older brother Minsu inspect the sunroom walls with Mina and confirm the room has wonderful natural sound.

scenes.title: Postcards from May
scenes.summary: Over mid-morning tea, Sora, Youngmi, and Junho read the old postcards from the cedar box and learn Room 9 once hosted Friday tea concerts.

scenes.title: Count the Coins
scenes.summary: Sungmin worries about the cost of renovating Room 9 until Mina and Sora show him a simple low-cost budget.

scenes.title: Don't Touch That Switch
scenes.summary: Sungmin eagerly flips the old brass wall switch in Room 9 before Junho can check the wires, blowing the ground-floor fuse.
